title: System Context Diagram
alt: Praetor boundaries, agent interactions, git providers, and downstream infrastructure.
text: Boxes: Engineer / Operator, AI Coding Agent (fed by compile-context), Operational Fork (operator data), Git Provider (GitHub enforces), ARC Runner Scale Sets (fork deploy/arc/), GitOps Controller (fork deploy/k8s/).
AI Coding Agent → Praetor Engine (reads AGENTS.md).
Operational Fork → Praetor Engine (demand) → Operational Fork (sync).
Praetor Engine → ARC Runner Scale Sets (runner labels).
demand is the .needs.yaml report praetorctl needs aggregates; sync is praetorctl operational, which prepares the fork from reviewed engine commits.
The runner labels and the deployed chart meet owner-only fork paths; Praetor dispatches no jobs.

Text description
  • Praetor Boundary: Praetor Engine (praetorctl).
  • Boxes: Engineer / Operator, AI Coding Agent (fed by compile-context), Operational Fork (operator data), Git Provider (GitHub enforces), ARC Runner Scale Sets (fork deploy/arc/), GitOps Controller (fork deploy/k8s/).
  • Engineer / Operator → Praetor Engine (runs praetorctl).
  • AI Coding Agent → Praetor Engine (reads AGENTS.md).
  • Operational Fork → Praetor Engine (demand) → Operational Fork (sync).
  • Praetor Engine → Git Provider (branch protection).
  • Praetor Engine → ARC Runner Scale Sets (runner labels).
  • GitOps Controller → Praetor Engine (deploys chart).
  • demand is the .needs.yaml report praetorctl needs aggregates; sync is praetorctl operational, which prepares the fork from reviewed engine commits.
  • The runner labels and the deployed chart meet owner-only fork paths; Praetor dispatches no jobs.
